$comment: COVERAGE BASELINE for the published-bytes gate (scripts/check-registry-sync.ts).
It records the EXACT set of registry rows that must carry an npm-package: locator and be
verified against the bytes npm currently serves. The gate asserts SET EQUALITY, so it fails
both when a row silently disappears or loses its locator (the scope-narrowing failure this
file exists to stop: an all-jsdelivr registry used to be reported as a PASS with zero rows
verified) and when a row is ADDED without a deliberate edit here — that edit is the review
signal that a newly published package has entered the gate.
This is NOT registry/index.json. It holds no checksums and is never machine-regenerated;
edit it by hand, in the same commit that publishes or retires a package.
